title: A new conclusion changes a familiar picture

captions.physics: Ending a formula of apparent agreement
captions.energy: Including an actual answer in wholeness

meaning: You can end a formula of apparent agreement and include an actual answer even when the familiar picture of conversation changes sharply.
text: Death in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in ending a formula of apparent agreement. The World in energy supports a wish to include a genuine answer in a whole exchange rather than leave it outside a pleasant conclusion. The Tower in emotions brings an abrupt experience of difference. Wanting greater wholeness can reveal something previously unheard. A changed picture concerns this conversation rather than proving all earlier closeness mistaken.

For example, you stop saying “Everything is fine” at an ending when one request remains unanswered. You name it directly: whether you are both willing to continue tomorrow needs clarification. **A genuine conclusion can include an unexpected difference**. It emerges that continuation seemed promised in only one reading. The picture of finished agreement changes sharply. An actual answer can now be heard without making a calm earlier tone proof of consent or the discovered difference rejection of all communication.

Sharpness grows if a whole conclusion must immediately be restored through any agreement. Ending one formula then creates another equally distant from a real answer. The constructive World helps include an open question in the picture too. You can finish the present exchange with clearly named disagreement or unreadiness; a broken assumption need not make you urgently create a more convenient appearance of a shared position between you.
